prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 51px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 48px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 239px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 523px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 522px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示主要财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，并用同比和备注补充解释。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三年数值和同比；备注提供原因或背景。各行应保持清楚的视觉对应关系。","groups":["2022 年、2023 年、2024 年：同一指标的连续年度数值，适合采用相同或接近的列宽，便于横向比较。","同比与年度数值：都是用于判断变化的数字，应保持数值完整。","指标与备注：分别承担行标识和文字说明；指标需要易于定位，备注可利用行高换行。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值、百分比、正负号及百分比单位","指标名称中的数字、单位和括号尽量保持完整","年份表头尽量保持单行"],"may_wrap":["较长的备注可按中文语义自然换行，并与所属数据行对齐。","较长的指标名称可在自然位置换行；已有备注换行形成的行高可容纳指标换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [98, 71, 71, 71, 69, 142] · table 523×260px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [105, 71, 71, 71, 69, 135] · table 523×280px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 73, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"三年数值列等宽，便于横向比较；年度表头、数值和同比均保持完整。备注最多两行，各数据行的对应关系清楚。","problems":"指标名称多处换行，经营性现金流的名称被拆在“流”之前，阅读略显生硬；第一条备注末尾只有一个“量”，形成孤字。","cause":"指标列宽98px，正文可用77px，不足以容纳较长指标名称；备注列宽142px，正文可用121px，第一条备注恰好超出一行容量。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"数值列保持等宽，表头和数字完整；指标列稍宽，使经营性现金流的名称能够保持在一起。","problems":"两个指标的“亿元”单位在括号内被拆行；研发投入的备注增至三行，拉高整行并削弱表格的紧凑节奏。","cause":"指标列宽105px，正文可用84px，仍不足以容纳完整名称及单位；备注列缩至135px，正文可用114px，不足以让较长的研发备注在两行内排完。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[93,71,71,71,69,147],"change":"以r1A为基础，将指标列缩窄5px并转给备注列，尝试消除首条备注的孤字，同时保留年度数值列等宽和完整数值。需观察较窄的指标列是否产生更生硬的换行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[90,71,71,71,69,150],"change":"进一步增加备注列宽，尝试改善长备注的断行；指标列利用备注已形成的行高换行。该方案用于比较文字断行质量，重点检查指标名称和单位是否仍易读。"}]}
